points.quote: **Framework (`blocksuite/framework/`)** has four core packages: ... **Affine feature layer (`blocksuite/affine/`)** builds on the framework.
`store`: the Yjs-backed document model, meaning blocks, schemas and transactions.
`std`: the runtime for block views, selection, commands and the canvas (gfx).
**`widgets/`**: UI overlays such as the drag handle, slash menu, toolbar, ... **`fragments/`**: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, adapter-panel and doc-title.
Blocks, widgets, inlines and gfx elements each ship their own store and view extensions. `std` collects those extensions into an editor.
`blocksuite/` doesn't import anything outside itself. ... In short, AFFiNE doesn't fork the editor. It composes BlockSuite packages and adds its own extensions
